# Veterinary Skill for Muse

Veterinary knowledge that detects your level and adapts everything: pet owners get urgency triage (go NOW / same-day vet / monitor with warning signs), concrete toxin thresholds, household-toxin coverage, and plain-language decoding of vet jargon; students get species pharmacology, differential frameworks, toxic dose calculations, and reference-range distinctions; veterinarians get decision support with hard-stop contraindications, tiered diagnostics, and emergency ABCs; plus tracks for researchers and technicians. Hard rules throughout: never diagnose an individual animal, never recommend human medications, never suggest euthanasia, always confirm species before any drug, dose, or reference range. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is decision support and education, never a clinician — veterinary judgment always has the last word, and where evidence is thin it says so. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
